tasks.name: routing_cost
tasks.label: Routing: cost
tasks.title: Model routing, performance and cost (13 flagship models)
tasks.decision: Which task type and difficulty is the request? Avengers-Pro's lookup sends each bucket to the model with the best balance of accuracy and cost.

tasks.name: routing_perf
tasks.label: Routing: per request
tasks.title: Model routing per request: which requests need the stronger model?
tasks.decision: How hard is the request, and what does it need? A ridge regression on the answers predicts how much Qwen3-8B gains over Llama-3.1-8B on it, and within each benchmark requests go to Qwen3-8B in that order.
tasks.data: LLMRouterBench lightweight setting: 11,467 requests from 15 datasets, Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and Qwen3-8B

tasks.name: reasoning_budget
tasks.label: Thinking
tasks.title: Reasoning budget: turn thinking on only where it pays
tasks.decision: Does the request need thinking? Thinking is switched on first for the requests rated most likely to need it.
tasks.data: LLMRouterBench: Qwen3-235B-A22B with and without thinking, 7 datasets, 3,713 requests

tasks.name: cascade_verifier
tasks.label: Cascade
tasks.title: Cascade verifier: keep the cheap model's answer or escalate to GPT-5
tasks.decision: Is the cheap model's answer correct? The answers it doubts most are escalated to GPT-5 first.

tasks.name: semantic_cache
tasks.label: Semantic cache
tasks.title: Semantic cache: return the cached answer to a similar earlier request?
tasks.decision: Would the cached answer to the most similar earlier request (by embedding) correctly answer this one? The cache returns it when the model says yes.
tasks.data: vCache SemBenchmarkLmArena: 10,000 LM Arena requests in known equivalence classes, GPT-4o-mini answers
anchors: a cache that knows which requests are equivalent

tasks.name: context_filter
tasks.label: Context filter
tasks.title: Context filter: which retrieved passages are worth the prefill?
tasks.decision: Does this retrieved passage contain information needed to answer the question? Passages the model rules out are dropped before prefill.
tasks.data: HotpotQA distractor: 500 questions × 10 retrieved passages, 2 of them needed
anchors: dropping exactly the passages that are not needed

tasks.name: prefix_cache
tasks.label: Prefix cache
tasks.title: Prefix cache: which conversations keep their KV in GPU memory?
tasks.decision: Will the user send another message in this conversation, and how soon? When the cache is full, the conversation least likely to be back within ten minutes, given how long it has been idle, goes first.
tasks.data: WildChat-1M: 8,000 conversations with their real reply times, in one H200's KV cache for Qwen3-8B
anchors: evicting by the true next-message times (Belady)

tasks.name: length_scheduling
tasks.label: Length
tasks.title: Output-length prediction for shortest-predicted-first scheduling
tasks.decision: How long will the answer be, and in what form? A ridge regression turns the answers into a predicted length, and the scheduler serves the shortest predicted request first.
tasks.data: ShareGPT: 20,000 requests answered by Qwen3-8B with thinking off and on

tasks.name: response_select
tasks.label: Best-of-N
tasks.title: Best-of-N: pick the right response out of four
tasks.decision: Is this a good response to the request? Each candidate is rated on its own and the highest-rated one is returned.
tasks.data: RewardBench 2, five subsets (Ties left out): 1,763 prompts, each with one correct and three wrong responses

tasks.name: step_verifier
tasks.label: Step check
tasks.title: Reasoning check: is every step of this solution correct?
tasks.decision: Is every step of this solution correct? Solutions the model doubts go back for another attempt.
tasks.data: ProcessBench: 3,400 solutions to GSM8K, MATH, OlympiadBench and Omni-MATH problems, 65% with a wrong step

tasks.name: grounding
tasks.label: Grounding
tasks.title: Grounding check: is the claim supported by the document?
tasks.decision: Is every part of the claim supported by the document?

tasks.name: safety
tasks.label: Safety
tasks.title: Guardrail: harmful requests and responses
tasks.decision: Is this request harmful, or an attempt to jailbreak the assistant? Is this response harmful?
tasks.data: ToxicChat test (5,083 requests), WildGuardTest (1,699 requests, 1,709 responses)

tasks.name: over_refusal
tasks.label: Over-refusal
tasks.title: Over-refusal: let borderline but harmless requests through
tasks.decision: Is this request harmful? The safety task's question, asked about requests that only look harmful, mixed with ones that are.
tasks.data: OR-Bench-Hard-1K (1,319 harmless) with OR-Bench-Toxic (655), XSTest (250 safe, 200 unsafe)

tasks.name: prompt_injection
tasks.label: Injection
tasks.title: Prompt injection: is the user trying to override the assistant's instructions?
tasks.decision: Does the user's message try to make the assistant ignore, override or reveal its instructions?
tasks.data: deepset prompt-injections: 662 messages in English and German, 40% of them injection attempts

tasks.name: tool_gate
tasks.label: Tool gate
tasks.title: Tool gate: call a tool, ask for details, or decline?
tasks.decision: With the tools it has, should the assistant call one, ask the user for missing details, say no tool fits, or answer directly?
tasks.data: When2Call: 3,652 requests with tool specifications, built from BFCL v2 Live

tasks.name: agent_risk
tasks.label: Agent risk
tasks.title: Risky-action check: does the agent's behaviour create a safety risk?
tasks.decision: Do the agent's actions in this interaction create a safety risk or cause harm?
tasks.data: R-Judge: 571 agent interactions from 27 scenarios in 5 application areas

categories.name: Route
categories.blurb: Which model, or which mode, serves the request.

categories.name: Cache
categories.blurb: What to reuse, and what to keep in memory or in the context.

categories.name: Verify
categories.blurb: Whether a finished answer is good enough to return.

categories.name: Guard
categories.blurb: Whether a request or a response is let through.

categories.name: Act
categories.blurb: Whether an agent's next step goes ahead.
